d:
Jharkhand Vidhansabha men SIR mudde par Babulal Marandi par phayar hue Pradip Yadav, kya kaha sunie?
Jharkhand men SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ke mudde par siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. vidhayak pradip yadav ne bijepi pradesh adhyaksh babulal marandi par tikha hamla bola. aakhir SIR ko lekar pradip yadav ne kya kuchh kaha aur babulal marandi par kyon sadha nishana? dekhie puri khabra.
